from dataclasses import asdict
    selected,bindings=[],[]
    for assembly,e,special,body,decoded in pairs:
        if assembly not in forms:
            continue
        for route in ['raw','direct']:
            step=(f'X86_SIM_RUN_OP({e.op}, {e.dst}, {e.src}, '
                  f'{e.flags}, {e.aux}, {e.imm})') if route=='raw' else None
            selected.append((assembly,e,step,body,decoded))
            bindings.append(dict(form=len(selected)-1,assembly=assembly,route=route,encoded=asdict(e)))
    assert len(selected)==32
    pairs=selected
    (out/'numeric-bindings.json').write_text(json.dumps(bindings,indent=2)+'\n')
